method: Code geometry, oblique 90-degree wedge; curved graphite hatching and porous stone marks only.

alt.en: Oblique wedge cut through a hard-coral polyp and its ribbed, porous skeletal cup, with twelve upright rim tentacles, an oval mouth, descending soft column, six thin septa and a small columella.
alt.zh: 硬珊瑚虫与有肋纹、孔隙的骨骼杯的斜切剖面：口盘边缘有十二根向上伸展的触手、椭圆小口，软体柱向杯内延伸，杯内有六片薄隔片和小中轴。

caption.en: A quarter wedge exposes the soft column inside the calcareous cup. Six skeletal septa project inward around a small columella; twelve tentacles rise from the surviving oral-disc rim. Enlarged general teaching model.
caption.zh: 切去约四分之一的楔形部分，显示石灰质杯内的软体柱。六片骨骼隔片向小中轴伸出，十二根触手从保留的口盘边缘向上伸展。一般硬珊瑚的放大教学模型。

checks: Oblique wedge continues through living column and calcareous cup; no mouth-shaped front window or separate tissue lid.
Twelve blunt, tapering tentacles rise from the surviving rim; small oval mouth; six thin radial septa stop short of the small columella.
Cup has longitudinal costae and irregular pores; tissue and skeleton are modelled by hatching, with no flat grey or noise-texture fills.

method: Code-drawn cumulonimbus silhouette and irregular section; scattered hydrometeors with fixed coordinates, graphite hatching and fading rain strokes.

alt.en: A tall cumulonimbus tower spreads into a wide anvil. An irregular cutaway shows scattered small ice plates above a faint dashed freezing-level line, varied droplets below it and soft slanting rain under the base.
alt.zh: 高耸的积雨云塔向上铺展成宽阔云砧；不规则剖面中，淡虚线冰点层上方散布小冰片，下方散布大小不同的水滴，云底下是柔和的斜雨线。

caption.en: Ice plates occupy the upper section, above the dashed 0 °C level; droplets occupy the lower section. A few particles are enlarged. Rain streaks fade beneath the cloud base.
caption.zh: 上部冰片位于虚线所示的 0 °C 层以上，下部为水滴；少量粒子已放大。云底下的雨线逐渐淡去。

checks: Tall convective tower narrows into the broad anvil; irregular opening has no rectangular window or box walls.
Scattered un-faceted ice plates are above the freezing line; varied droplets below; no rows, grid or glass marbles.
Slanting rain is made from soft, staggered, fading graphite strokes; no icicle-shaped shafts.

method: Targeted edit of original graphite image with Gary Todd CC0 Du tally outline reference; deterministic mirroring of the edited half.

alt.en: Two matching longitudinal halves of a bronze walking-tiger tally face opposite directions, with rounded ears, a compact body, short legs, curled raised tails and blank inscription fields.
alt.zh: 两片青铜行虎形虎符的纵向半片朝向相反，并排摆放：圆耳、紧凑躯干、短腿、翘起卷尾，铭文区留白，两片轮廓互为镜像。

caption.en: Matching tiger-tally halves, with the walking outline adapted from the Du tally. The inscription fields are left blank.
caption.zh: 配对虎符半片，行虎轮廓参照杜虎符，铭文区留白。

checks: Original graphite bronze surface retained through a targeted edit; every fake glyph removed and inscription fields blank.
Complete walking-tiger silhouette has rounded ears, thick short neck, compact body, short legs and raised curled tail.
The two halves are exact reflected copies of one contour, verified against flipped decoded pixels before export.

method: Code structure traced/adapted from Gary Todd CC0 mechanism photograph and the standard assembled/parts diagram; graphite hatching only.

alt.en: A bronze crossbow mechanism separated along its two pin axes: rectangular guo housing with two bores, a single wangshan-and-two-ya casting, a compact gouxin cam, a hanging xuandao blade and two pins.
alt.zh: 沿两根销钉轴线分开的青铜弩机：带两个销孔的长方体郭、望山与双牙一体件、小钩心凸轮、下垂悬刀，以及两根销钉。

caption.en: Pulling the xuandao frees the gouxin cam, allowing the two ya teeth to drop. The parts separate along the pin axes; the blade hangs below the guo floor.
caption.zh: 扣动悬刀使钩心脱开，双牙随之落下。各部件沿销钉轴线分开显示；悬刀下垂至郭的底部以下。

checks: Plain rectangular guo has two pin bores; both explosion directions are parallel to the transverse pin axes, with dashed alignment guides.
Wangshan and two solid ya teeth belong to one casting; gouxin is a compact rocking cam, not a hinged connecting rod.
Xuandao descends below housing floor and aligns with the rear pin; exactly two pins, no floating off-axis fasteners or glyph-like decoration.

method: Code construction adapted from Philg88 CC0 reconstruction, horse anatomy from Gary Todd CC0 Qin horse references; form-following graphite hatching only.

alt.en: A two-horse chariot with stocky horses, one curved central pole joining a transverse heng, two inverted-V yoke saddles above the withers, a small square box over its axle and two large many-spoked wheels.
alt.zh: 双马战车：两匹体形敦实的马，一根弯曲的中央辕连接横衡，两副倒 V 形轭架在马的肩颈上方，小方车舆居于车轴上，两只大轮有密集辐条。

caption.en: One curved pole connects the box underside to the centre of the heng. Two saddle yokes rest over the horses’ withers; the axle lies beneath the box centre. Vehicle geometry follows a pre-Han reconstruction.
caption.zh: 一根曲辕从车舆底部连到横衡中央，两副轭架在马的肩颈上；车轴位于车舆中央下方。车体结构参照先秦战车复原图。

checks: Exactly one curved pole joins box underside to heng centre; two inverted-V yoke saddles rest above the withers, not below the chins.
Small square box sits over one centred axle; two large wheels each have twenty-eight spokes.
Two stocky horses have anatomical head, neck, barrel, knees, hocks and hooves; plain vehicle has no glyph-like ornament or invented AI connections.
